title: Iman Nyang Meusöm Lam Bintéh Istana .
intro: Di teungoh-teungoh saboh istana tirani nyang peunoh ngon komplotan dan keusombongan, sidroe jiwa nyang sidroe-droe jimat rahasia nyang bahaya. Dikeulileng lé kuasa dan ancaman maté, hamba Allah nyoe geukaloen sidroe utusan geudong sidroe geulawan saboh keurajeuen. Watèë seungap djeuët keu kompleksitas, keputusan njang beuhe harôih dipeugot untôk peugah haba njang beutôi deungon resiko pribadi njang rajek.
clues: Lon tinggai lamkawan kawôm nyang meukuasa ngon sombong nyang jitulak tanda-tanda Allah.
Lon peusöm iman lon keu siat watee ureung-ureung di sekitar lon meukomplot keu sidroe utusan.
Lon peugah haba deungon trang-trang, lon peugah: Peu kheueh gata tapeumate sidroe-droe ureueng sabab awaknyan jipeugah, Tuhan lon na kheueh Allah, seudangkan bukti-bukti nyang jeulaih ka teuka?
Lon peuingat keu bansa lon teuntang nasib bansa-bansa awai dan teuntang saboh Uroe Saleng Panggilan.
Lon peugah bak awak njan bahwa peunguasa njang lon layani njan djipeuleumah peundapat njang sempit mantong, bah that pih meunan akhirat nakeuh rumoh njang beutôi.
Lon peugah: Hai umat lon, seutot lon dan lon bimbing gata u jalan nyang beutoi, dan Allah geupeuseulamat lon nibak keujahatan reuncana awaknyan.

identity.label: Soe Lon?
options: Abu lahab
Qarun
Seubagoe Sami
Haman
Ureung Mukmin dari Keluarga Fir'aun

trial.label: Peu Nyang Lon Peugot?
options: Meukumpôi harta nyang kunci jih meubeuban keu ureuëng-ureuëng nyang teuga .
Geupeudong saboh meunara nyang manyang keu geukaloen dewa Musa .
Iman nyang teusöm teuma deungon teubuka geubela Musa dan geupeuingat umat ulôn .
Dipeugot saboh aneuk leumo meuh nyang jipeugot su nyang meu-ulang-ulang .
Dihalangi jalan Nabi dan diejek wahyu demi kekayaan
trial.answer: Iman nyang teusöm teuma deungon teubuka geubela Musa dan geupeuingat umat ulôn .

location.label: Dipat Kisah Lon Meulangsong?
options: Bahtera di ateueh ié raya .
Masjid Haram di Mekkah .
Mahkamah Istana Firaun di Meusé
Gua ureueng teungeut .
Lembah Madyan nyang meu-ukheue .

outcome.label: Peue Hase Lon?
options: Lon karam ngon teuntra lam laot nyang ka teubagi .
Bumoe jiteubiet ulôn deungon hareuta ulôn .
Saboh kilat jidrob ulôn ngon Thamud .
Ulôn ka jeuet keu kera sabab lôn iengkeue uroe Sabat .
Allah peulindong ulôn nibak keujahatan komplotan awaknyan .
outcome.answer: Allah peulindong ulôn nibak keujahatan komplotan awaknyan .

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
